resources.string: Sending in two steps
This payment to an exchange (TEX) address is sent in two steps. The first step is on its way. Do not send this payment again.
This payment to an exchange (TEX) address is sent in two steps. The first step arrived and the second is on its way. Do not send this payment again.
Not sent
Neither step of this payment to an exchange (TEX) address went through, and they can no longer. Nothing left your wallet. You can send the payment again.
Checking a payment to an exchange

The second step of this payment to an exchange (TEX) address has not been confirmed. ZCHAT is checking whether it went through. If it did not, the exchange was not paid and ZCHAT moves the ZEC back into your wallet by itself. Do not send this payment again yet.

The second step of this payment to an exchange (TEX) address has not been confirmed. To check whether it went through, ZCHAT turns on Tor by itself as soon as no send or call is in progress. If it did not go through, the exchange was not paid and ZCHAT moves the ZEC back into your wallet by itself. Do not send this payment again yet.

The second step of this payment to an exchange (TEX) address has not been confirmed. ZCHAT could not connect over Tor yet to check whether it went through, and keeps trying. Do not send this payment again yet.

The second step of this payment to an exchange (TEX) address has not been confirmed. ZCHAT needs Tor to check whether it went through, and Tor was turned off, so ZCHAT does not turn it on again by itself. Turn it on in More → Advanced Settings → Beta: Tor Protection; ZCHAT then checks and, if the exchange was not paid, moves the ZEC back into your wallet by itself. Do not send this payment again yet.
Moving your ZEC back
The exchange was not paid. ZCHAT found the ZEC of this payment and moves it back into your wallet by itself. Do not send this payment again yet.

The exchange was not paid. ZCHAT found the ZEC of this payment and will move it back by itself after the other transparent ZEC in your wallet has been shielded (Shield Now on the wallet screen). Do not send this payment again yet.
The exchange was not paid. ZCHAT is moving %1$s ZEC back into your wallet; the network fee of %2$s ZEC comes out of it. Do not send this payment again yet.
Your ZEC is back in your wallet

Your payment to an exchange (TEX) address did not reach the exchange, so the exchange was not paid. ZCHAT found the ZEC and moved %1$s ZEC back into your wallet. The network fee was %2$s ZEC, taken from that amount, so %3$s ZEC arrived. You can send the payment again now.

Your payment to an exchange (TEX) address did not reach the exchange, so the exchange was not paid. ZCHAT turned on Tor to check, found the ZEC and moved %1$s ZEC back into your wallet. The network fee was %2$s ZEC, taken from that amount, so %3$s ZEC arrived. You can send the payment again now.\n\nTor is now on and stays on. ZCHAT also uses it to send and receive chat files and to fetch what a call needs to connect, which can be slower. You can turn it off in More → Advanced Settings → Beta: Tor Protection.
This payment needs support

The exchange was not paid. ZCHAT found the ZEC of this payment at an address of your wallet but could not move it back by itself: it is too little to move after the network fee, or moving it did not work several times. ZCHAT has not sent it anywhere else. Contact support, and do not send this payment again yet.
Checking which payment this is

This payment was sent at almost the same time as another payment, and ZCHAT cannot tell yet whether it is one step of a payment to an exchange (TEX) address. ZCHAT does not move anything for it by itself. Do not send this payment again yet. If this is still shown once all your payments are confirmed, contact support.
ZCHAT is checking whether the exchange was paid. Do not send it again yet.
The exchange was not paid. ZCHAT moves the ZEC back by itself.
%1$s ZEC arrived back (network fee %2$s ZEC). Tap to read more.
The exchange was not paid. Tap to read what to do.
ZCHAT cannot tell two payments apart yet. Do not send them again yet.
